F101030.title: Large shopping malls are replacing small shops. What is your opinion about this? Is it a positive development or a negative one? Discuss with appropriate examples.
F101030.title_zh: 大型购物商场在取代小商店，这是个好现象吗？

blocks.p: Large shopping malls are replacing small shops. What is your opinion about this? Is it a positive development or a negative one? Discuss with appropriate examples.
大型购物商场在取代小商店，这是个好现象吗？
In many towns and cities, large shopping malls are replacing small local shops. Do you think this is a positive development? Give your reasons and examples.
在许多城镇和城市,大型购物商场正在取代当地的小商店。你认为这是一个积极的发展吗？给出你的理由和例子。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：是一个积极的发展
Personally speaking, large shopping malls replacing small local shops is a positive development.
论点1：削减生活开支***
Large shopping malls can reduce the cost of living.
论证：大
型购物中心的运营– 多品牌的集中 – 消费者选择便宜的商品
[the operation of large shopping malls] – [the concentration of multiple brands] – [more affordable choices for consumers]
例子：购物中心内的
假日促销活动– 日用品的花费较低
[holiday discount campaigns in big shopping malls] – [lower spending on daily necessities]
论点2：提高就业率***
Large shopping malls can improve the employment rate.
论证：大规模商场 – 对服务和管理人才的需求 – 更多就业机会
[large-scale shopping malls] – [increased labor demand such as service and management personnel] – [more employment opportunities]
例子：大型商场的入驻 – 对零售销售人员的需求
[the arrival of large malls] – [higher demand for retail sales staff]
论点3：提供更完善的设施和购物环境
Large shopping malls provide better facilities and a more comfortable shopping environment.
论证：购物中心的设计– 停车、空调和休息区 – 消费者购物体验的改善
[the design of big shopping malls] – [enough parking lots, air conditioning and rest areas] – [an improvement in consumers' shopping experience]
例子：现代化商场的舒适环境– 消费意愿的增加
[the comfortable environment of modern malls] – [consumers’ greater willingness to spend]
观点
2：不是一个积极的发展
Personally speaking, large shopping malls replacing small local shops is a not positive development.
论点
1：限制小商户的发展
Large shopping malls replacing small shops can hinder the development of small businesses.
论证：大型连锁商场的进驻 – 小商店客流量的流失 – 本地的商家难以生存
[the entry of large chain malls] – [the loss of customer base for small shops] – [the little survival space for local stores]
例子：大型超市进入社区– 家庭杂货店倒闭
[the arrival of a major supermarket in community] – [the closure of family grocery shops]
论点
加剧交通拥堵与环境压力
Large shopping malls can worsen traffic congestion and environmental pressure.
论证：购物中心的吸引– 大量车流和人流的汇聚 – 交通拥堵和污染的加剧
[the attraction of shopping malls] – [large volumes of vehicles and pedestrians] – [heavy traffic congestion and pollution]
例子：商场停车场的爆满– 周边道路拥堵和碳排放的增加
[the overcrowding of mall parking lots] – [an increase in road congestion and carbon emissions]
论点
降低本地商业与产品的多样性
The replacement of local shops can reduce commercial and product diversity in town centers.
论证：标准化连锁商店的到来 – 独立小店的批量倒闭 – 缺乏本地特色
[the arrival of standardized chain stores] – [the mass closure of independent shops] – [fewer distinctive towns and neighborhood characters]
例子
：本地手工艺店被统一品牌替代– 街区特色减少
[local craft shops replaced by identical franchises] – [the loss of local specialty products]

F101039.title: Medical technology is responsible for increasing the average life expectancy. Do you think it is a blessing or a curse？
F101039.title_zh: 先进的医疗技术延长了人们的寿命。你觉得这件事情是好事还是坏事？

blocks.p: Medical technology is responsible for increasing the average life expectancy. Do you think it is a blessing or a curse？
先进的医疗技术延长了人们的寿命。你觉得这件事情是好事还是坏事？

F101039.title: 医学技术延长人们寿命是好是坏

blocks.p: Medical technology is responsible for increasing the average life expectancy. Do you think it is a curse or a blessing?
医学的技术提高了人们的平均预期寿命。你觉得这是诅咒还是福祉？
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点 1：是福
Personally speaking, the increase in life expectancy brought by advanced technology is a blessing.
论点1: 为终身学习提供更多机会
Longer and healthier lives can provide greater opportunities for lifelong learning.
论证：更长的健康成年期– 在50岁以后仍然有接受继续教育的机会 – 更广的个人技能
[a longer period of healthy adulthood] – [more time and opportunities for further education after 50 years old] – [broader personal skills]
例子 ：退休人员有体力完
成线上语言课程– 海外旅行沟通更顺畅
[having the physical strength to complete online language courses] – [easier communication during overseas travel]
论点2：延长寿命让人们享受更多人生时光
Longer life expectancy allows people to enjoy more time in life.
论证：医疗技术的进步– 寿命的延长 – 个人人生体验和家庭陪伴的增加
[the advancement of medical technology] – [the extension of lifespan] – [an increase in personal life experiences and family companionship]
例子：老年人的健康长寿– 祖孙相处和家庭幸福感的增强
[the healthy longevity of the elderly] – [stronger intergenerational bonds and greater family happiness]
论点3：老年人口的经验和智慧对社会有贡献
The experience and wisdom of the elderly contribute to society.
论证：寿命的延长– 老年人口参与社会的时间增加 – 社会经验的传承
[the extension of lifespan] – [more time for the elderly to participate in society] – [the transmission of abundant social experience]
例子：资深专家和导师的长期活跃– 年轻一代成长的受益
[the long-term activity of senior experts and mentors] – [benefits for the growth of the younger generation]
观点 2：是祸
Personally speaking, the extension of life expectancy caused by advanced technology can be a curse.
论点1：降低年轻人就业率***
Longer life expectancy caused by advanced technology may limit the employment rate for young people.
论证：更长的职业生涯– 对工作岗位和工作资源的占据 – 年轻人更少就业机会
[longer careers for elders] – [occupation of limited job positions and work resources] – [fewer employment opportunities for younger generation]
例子：高级管理者晚退休 – 初级员工晋升推迟
[later retirement of senior managers] – [delayed promotion for junior employees]
论点2：破坏环境***
Longer life expectancy caused by advanced technology can damage the environment.
论证：人均寿命的延长– 人口总量增加并且对自然资源的需求
增长– 自然资源的压力加剧
[the extension of average life expectancy] – [increased population and demand on natural resources] – [huge pressure on the environment]
例子：人口膨胀– 粮食、水资源和能源短缺风险的过度使用
[population expansion by longer life span] – [the overuse of food, water and energy resources]
论点3：增加医疗系统压力
Longer life expectancy brought by medical technology can place greater pressure on healthcare systems.
论证：老年人口增加– 更高的医疗和养老需求 – 占据公共服务资源
[a larger elderly population] – [a surge in the demand for public healthcare and aged care] – [greater occupancy of public services]
例子：老年人医疗需
求增长– 其他人群在医院候诊时间延长
[growing demand of elders for medical care] – [longer hospital waiting times for other age groups]

F101040.title: Some people point that experiential learning, like learning by doing it, can do well in formal education. Nonetheless, others think a traditional form of teaching is the best. Do you think experiential learning can work well in high school or colleges?
F101040.title_zh: 经验教学可以在高中和大学教育里获得成功吗？

blocks.p: Some people point that experiential learning, like learning by doing it, can do well in formal education. Nonetheless, others think a traditional form of teaching is the best. Do you think experiential learning can work well in high school or colleges?
经验教学可以在高中和大学教育里获得成功吗？

F101040.title: 体验式学习在学校有无好处

blocks.p: Some people point out that experiential learning (i.e. learning by doing) can work well in formal education. However, others think a traditional form of teaching is the best. Do you think experiential learning is beneficial in high school or college?
有些人指出，体验式学习（即通过“实践”来学习）在正统教育中效果很好。然而，其他人认为传统的教学形式是最好的。你认为体验式学习在高中或大学是有益的吗?
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1： 体验式学习有益
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that experiential learning is extremely beneficial in high school or college. 论点
1：实践技能
Experiential learning can develop students’ practical skills.
论证：在“做中学” – 应用理论知识并解决实际挑战 – 更强的问题处理能力
[the process of learning by doing] – [the application of theory and resolution of practical challenges] – [stronger problem-solving skills]
例子
：实验室操作训练– 学生动手能力和逻辑思维能力提高
[laboratory training] – [enhanced hands-on abilities and critical thinking skills]
论点2：知识掌握***
Learning by doing can deepen students' mastery of knowledge.
论证：主动应用知识– 抽象知识与具体经验的结合 – 更持久的记忆
[active application of knowledge] – [the integration of abstract knowledge with concrete experience] – [longer knowledge retention]
例子
：完成校园调查– 更好地理解统计方法
[conducting a school survey] – [a better understanding of statistical methods]
论点3：找工作有竞争力
Experiential learning can lead to stronger competitiveness in job hunting.
论证：参加
团队项目–
协作能力发展– 更具职场竞争力
[participating in team-based projects] – [the development of collaborative skills] – [enhanced advantages in the job market]
例子 ：参加国际商业
项目– 有能力应聘外企的工作岗位
[joining an international business project] – [ability to apply for job positions in foreign enterprises]
观点
2：体验式学习无益
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that experiential learning is not beneficial in high school or college.
论点
难以系统、正确地传授覆盖知识
Experiential learning cannot deliver knowledge systematically and correctly.
论证：体验式活动的开展– 大量时间在操作和试错上的消耗 – 错误理解概念性知识
[the conduct of experiential activities] – [the consumption of time in trial and error] – [students’ inaccurate understanding of conceptual knowledge]
例子：无指导的实验操作– 学生错误结论的形成
[unguided experimental operations] – [the formation of incorrect conclusions]
论点
2：降低学习效率
Experiential learning can cause decreased learning efficiency.
论证：自主探索的模式– 教师系统讲解的缺失 – 更慢的教学进度
[the mode of self-exploration] – [the absence of teacher instruction] – [slower learning progress]
例子 ：冗长的实践项目 – 知识吸收效率的降低
[lengthy practical projects] – [a reduced efficiency of mastering knowledge]
论点
3：学生评估困难
Experiential learning can lead to difficulty in student performance evaluation.
论证：探索式学习 – 开放式学习成果需要
主观的评价– 成绩公平性下降
[exploratory learning] – [open learning outcomes that need subjective evaluation] – [lower assessment fairness] 例子 ：体验式学习 – 教学效果可比性的下降因为评分标准不一致
[experiential learning] – [low comparability of teaching outcomes for inconsistent marking standards]

F101042.title: Parents should be held legally responsible for what their children have done. What’s your opinion? Support it with examples.
F101042.title_zh: 家长应该为孩子的行为负法律责任吗?

blocks.p: Parents should be held legally responsible for what their children have done. What’s your opinion? Support it with examples.
家长应该为孩子的行为负法律责任吗?

F101042.title: 家长需要为孩子的行为负法律责任吗

blocks.p: Should parents be held legally responsible for the actions of their children? Do you agree with this opinion? Support your position with your own study, experience or observations.
父母应该为孩子的行为承担法律责任吗?你同意这个观点吗？用你自己的研究、经验或观察来支持你的观点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：应该承担
Personally speaking, parents should be held legally responsible for the actions of their children.
论点
建立社会责任感***
Parents holding legal responsibility for their children’s actions can build social responsibility among teenagers. 论证：父母的监护义务– 对子女行为的引导和约束 – 对社会有益的行为习惯的建立
[parents' duty of guardianship] – [the guidance and restraint of children's behavior] – [the establishment of beneficial behavior for society]
例子：家长履行监管义务 – 遵守公共秩序和社会道德
[parents' fulfillment of their supervisory duties] – [observance of public rules and social morality]
论点2：减少青少年犯罪***
Parents responsible for the actions of their children can reduce juvenile delinquency.
论证：法律责任的设定 – 家庭监管力度的增强 – 减少年轻人犯罪行为
[the establishment of parental legal responsibility] – [an increase in parental investment in supervision] – [reduced criminal activities of teenagers]
例子：民事罚款的威慑 – 更少的未成年暴力事件
[the deterrence of civil fines] – [fewer violent incidents caused by minors]
论点3：为受害者提供赔偿
Holding parents legally responsible provides compensation for victims.
论证：父母法律责任的承担– 对受害者损失的赔偿 – 代替孩子保证了受害者权益的保障
[the assumption of parents' legal responsibility] – [compensation for victims' losses] – [the protection of victims’ rights on behalf of their children]
例子：家长弥补未成年人造成的财产损失 – 受害者经济赔偿并维持社会公平
[parents making up for the property damage caused by minors] – [financial compensation and social fairness]
观点
2：不应承担
Personally speaking, parents should not be held legally responsible for the actions of their children.
论点
法律责任应该由非法行为的实施者承担
Legal responsibility should fall on the person who commits illegal actions.
论证：未成年人自主作出行为 – 知晓非法行为
的后果– 为自己的行为承担责任
[minors’ capacity to act independently] – [the awareness of the consequences of illegal behavior] – [the
assumption of legal consequences by the actors themselves]
例子：未成年人独立实施的违法行为– 行为人负法律责任而非家庭
[offences committed independently by minors] – [the liability by themselves rather than involvement of the family]
论点2：父母只有在存在明显疏忽时才应承担法律责任（不应因孩子违法就自动负责）
Parents should bear legal responsibility only in cases of negligence.
论证：父母监管能力的有限性– 已尽监管义务仍发生的违法行为 – 父母对孩子的个人错误无责
[the limited capacity of parental supervision] – [children’s offences despite reasonable supervision duties] – [zero parental liability for children’s personal faults]
例子：青少年故意违法– 为主动的行为选择承担法律惩罚
[deliberate violations by teenagers] – [legal punishment for their active behavioral choices]

F101043.title: Some universities will deduct marks from student’s work if it is submitted late. What is your opinion on this and what other action can solve this problem?
F101043.title_zh: 一些大学迟交作业会扣分。你的观点和解决办法是什么？

blocks.p: Some universities will deduct marks from student’s work if it is submitted late. What is your opinion on this and what other action can solve this problem?
一些大学迟交作业会扣分。你的观点和解决办法是什么？

F101043.title: 学校扣迟交作业学生的分数

blocks.p: Some universities deduct students’ marks if assignments are given late. What is your opinion and give your recommendations?
某些大学会对迟交的作业进行扣分。你的看法是什么？并给出你的建议。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点：
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that universities should / shouldn’t deduct students’ marks if an assignment is given late, and there are alternative recommendations.
Body Paragraph 1 – 同意
论点 1：时间管理***
Deducting students’ marks can improve their time management skills.
论证：迟交扣分的制度– 对截止日期的意识增强 – 学生时间规划的提升
[the policy of mark deduction for late submission] – [a stronger awareness of deadlines] – [an improvement in students' time planning]
例子：严格的截止日期执行– 学生拖延习惯的减少
[strict enforcement of deadlines] – [a reduction in students' procrastination]
论点 2：公平评估
Deducting marks for late assignments in universities can maintain fair evaluation among students.
论证：迟交扣分的实施– 对按时提交学生权益的保护 – 评分标准一致性的保障
[the implementation of mark deduction for late work] – [the protection of the rights of students who submit on time] – [the guarantee of consistency in grading standards]
例子：一致的扣分规则 – 学生积极性提升因为感受到了公平性
[policy consistent deduction rules] – [an increase in study motivation for a sense of fairness]
Body Paragraph 1 – 不同意
论点1：可能增加学生压力，影响学习效果
Mark deduction may increase student stress and affect learning outcomes.
论证：扣分惩罚的压力– 学生焦虑情绪的累积 – 学习专注度和知识吸收效果的下降
[the pressure of mark-deduction penalties] – [the accumulation of student anxiety] – [a decline in learning focus and knowledge absorption]
例子：
迟交论文几小时就拿低分– 身心疲惫
[getting a low grade for an essay submitted after the deadline for only a few hours] – [burnout and depression]
论点 2：可能导致学生抄袭
Mark deduction may lead to plagiarism.
论证：扣分压力的驱动– 对完成速度而非质量的追求 – 学术诚信的下降
[the pressure of mark deduction] – [the pursuit of speed over quality] – [a decrease in academic integrity]
例子：临近截止日期的仓促完成– 抄袭比例的上升
[rushed completion near deadlines] – [an increase in plagiarism]
Body Paragraph 2 – 方案
论点 1：发送邮件提醒***
Another recommendation is to send email reminders to students before the due date.
论证：自动截止提醒– 更早采取行动 – 更少由于忘记截止日期而迟交
[automated deadline reminders] – [earlier student action] – [fewer late submissions due to forgetting the deadline] 例子：截止前一周发送
邮件提醒– 更多学生按时提交
[an email reminder sent one week before the deadline] – [more on-time submissions]
论点2：设置合理的宽限期
Universities should set a reasonable grace period for late submissions.
论证：宽限期的设立– 轻微延误的包容 – 学生更高质量地完成作业
[the establishment of a grace period] – [tolerance for minor delays] – [a higher quality of students’ assignments] 例子：
24 至 48 小时的免罚宽限 –
因有足够时间处理难题而高质量完成作业
[a 24-to-48-hour penalty-free grace period] – [the quality completion of homework thanks to time available for handling difficult questions]
论点 3：允许特殊情况申请延期
Universities should allow extensions for special circumstances.
论证：延期申请机制 – 对特殊情况的接受 – 支持学生完成作业
[an extension application mechanism] – [the recognition of students’ special difficulties] – [the support for students to finish their homework]
例子：使用医疗证明
申请延期– 受身体原因影响学业的损失减少
[using medical certificates to apply for special consideration] – [a reduction in academic losses for illness-affected students]

F101044.title: In order to study efficiently, a student needs time, comfort and peace. Some people argue that it is impossible for a student to combine study with employment, as one distracts another. To what extent do you believe this statement is realistic?
F101044.title_zh: 工作学习不可兼得。是否同意？

blocks.p: In order to study efficiently, a student needs time, comfort and peace. Some people argue that it is impossible for a student to combine study with employment, as one distracts another. To what extent do you believe this statement is realistic?
工作学习不可兼得。是否同意？

In order to study effectively, it requires comfort, peace and time. So it is impossible for a student to combine learning and employment at the same time, because one distracts the other. Is it realistic to combine them at the same time in our life today? Support your opinion with examples.
有效的学习需要舒适平静的状态和充分的时间。因此一个学生不可能同时把学习和工作结合起来，因为两者会相互干扰。在我们今天的生活中，把它们同时结合起来现实吗?用例子来支持你的观点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：现实
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that it is realistic to combine learning and employment at the same time in our lives today.
论点
1：灵活
工作制度***
Flexible working systems can promote the realization of a study–work combination.
论证：远程办公和兼职工作– 根据自身需求灵活控制工作时长 – 学习与工作兼顾可行性的提高
[working from home and taking part-time jobs] – [the flexible adjustment of working hours based on self-needs] – [an improvement in the feasibility of combining study and work]
例子：远程办公的普及– 学生同时安排工作和学习
[the widespread adoption of remote work] – [the management of study and work tasks at the same time]
论点
科技发展***
The advancement of technology can combine work and study.
论证：
互联网和人工智能的发展–
在线教育和工作的应用– 学习和工作的生产力提升
[Internet and AI development] – [the application of online education and work tools] – [the improvement of work and study productivity]
例子：自动化与人工智能 – 快速同时完成工作和学习任务
[automation and artificial intelligence] – [the quick completion of work and study tasks at the same time]
论点
3：有效的时间管理可以平衡两者
Effective time management can help balance study and work.
论证：时间管理技能的运用– 学习和工作任务的合理分配 – 两者冲突和干扰的减少
[the application of time management skills] – [the reasonable allocation of study and work tasks] – [a reduction in conflicts and distractions between the two]
例子：制定详细的学习和工作计划– 学习效率和工作表现的同时保障
[the creation of detailed study and work plans] – [the simultaneous maintenance of academic performance and work output]
观点
2：不现实
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that it is not realistic to combine learning and employment at the same time in our life today.
论点
1：工作占用大量时间和精力，影响学习质量
Employment consumes time and energy, affecting the quality of learning.
论证：兼职工作– 学习时间和精力的分流 – 学业成绩和知识掌握程度的下降
[part-time work] – [the diversion of study time and energy] – [a decline in academic performance and knowledge mastery]
例子：长时间的工作排班– 学生缺课和作业完成质量的降低
[long work shifts] – [a lower quality of assignment completion]
论点
2：两者互相干扰，导致
心理压力过大
Studying and working at the same time can cause mental pressure.
论证：学习和工作的双重负担– 持续的压力和疲劳的累积 – 学生心理健康受损害
[the dual burden of study and work] – [the accumulation of stress and fatigue] – [damage to students' mental health]
例子：考试周与工作高峰期的重叠– 焦虑情绪和睡眠不足的加剧
[the overlap of exam weeks and peak work periods] – [an intensification of anxiety]
论点
3：深度学习需要专注，工作难以提供这样的条件
Deep learning requires focus, which employment cannot easily provide.
论证：深度学习的要求– 安静环境和高注意力的
需求– 与嘈杂工作环境和人们工作后的疲惫状态相冲突
[the requirements of deep learning] – [the need for a quiet environment and high attention level] – [a conflict with a noisy working environment and people’s state of fatigue after work]
例子：工作后的疲惫状态– 学生注意力和思考深度的明显下降
[the state of exhaustion after work] – [a noticeable decline in students' attention and the depth of thinking]

F101055.title: The world’s governments and organizations confront a multigrade of issues. Which do you think is the most pressing problem for the inhabitants on our planet and what solution would you offer?
F101055.title_zh: 人类面临最严重的问题是什么？怎样解决？

blocks.p: The world’s governments and organizations confront a multigrade of issues. Which do you think is the most pressing problem for the inhabitants on our planet and what solution would you offer?
人类面临最严重的问题是什么？怎样解决？

F101055.title: 政府面临的最严重的问题是什么

blocks.p: The world’s governments and organizations are facing a lot of issues. Which do you think is the most pressing problem for the inhabitants on our planet? And give solutions.
世界各国政府和组织正面临着许多问题。你认为对地球上的居民来说，哪一个是最紧迫的问题？并给出解决方案。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点：全球变暖，及其解决方案
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that global warming is the most pressing issue for the inhabitants on our planet, but there are solutions to it.
Body Paragraph 1 – 全球变暖
论点
1：生物多样性减少
Global warming can lead to the reduction of biodiversity.
论证：气候变暖的加速– 物种栖息地的消失 – 地球生态平衡的丧失
[the acceleration of climate warming] – [the disappearance of species habitats] – [the loss of ecological balance on Earth]
例子：频繁的由气候变暖引发的
森林火灾– 物种灭绝速度和生态不可逆损害的加快
[frequent forest fires caused by global warming] – [an acceleration of species extinction]
论点2：人类生存
Global warming is directly linked to human survival.
论证：全球变暖的加剧– 农业产量不稳定 – 粮食和人类生命安全的威胁
[the intensification of global warming] – [the instability of agricultural output] – [a threat to food and human life security]
例子：极端高温和干旱– 农作物减产和饥饿人群的增加
[extreme heat and drought] – [a decline in crop yields and an increase in the hungry population]
Body Paragraph 2 – 解决方案
论点
乘坐公共交通***
People should take public transport to tackle global warming.
论证：乘坐由电力驱动的公交车 –
更少的化石燃料使用– 更少的温室气体排放
[taking buses powered by electricity] – [less fossil-fuel use] – [reduced greenhouse gas emissions]
例子：电动公交作为通勤首选 – 城市二氧化碳排放下降且极端高温的日子越来越少
[taking electric buses as a daily commuting mode] – [lower urban carbon dioxide emissions and fewer days of extreme high temperature]
论点
大力开发可再生能源
Governments should develop renewable energy resources.
论证：可再生能源的推广– 对化石燃料依赖的降低 – 温室气体排放量的下降
[the promotion of renewable energy] – [a reduced reliance on fossil fuels] – [a decline in greenhouse gas
emissions]
例子：太阳能和风能的大规模应用– 气温上升速率的显著降低
[the large-scale application of solar and wind energy] – [a significant reduction in the rate of temperature rise]
论点3：通过植树去增强气候适应能力
The solution is to plant more trees to enhance climate adaptation.
论证：植树造林– 碳汇能力的增强 – 大气中二氧化碳浓度的降低
[afforestation] – [an enhancement of carbon absorption] – [a reduction of carbon dioxide concentration]
例子：森林保护 – 由气温上升造成的灾难数量减少
[forest conservation] – [a decrease in natural disasters caused by rising temperatures]

F101056.title: How do you think that the design of buildings has affected, either positively or negatively, on where people live and work?
F101056.title_zh: 建筑设计对人们的工作和生活有正面或负面影响吗？

blocks.p: How do you think that the design of buildings has affected, either positively or negatively, on where people live and work?
建筑设计对人们的工作和生活有正面或负面影响吗？

F101056.title: 建筑设计对工作生活的影响

blocks.p: How does the design of buildings affect, either positively or negatively, where people work and live? 建筑设计如何影响人们工作和生活的地方的，无论是积极的还是消极的？
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点：会影响工作和生活
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that the design of buildings affects where people work and live in both positive and negative ways.
Body Paragraph 1 – 对生活的影响
论点
精神压力***
Good building design can lead to less mental stress.
论证：
建筑设计的优化– 良好的通风和采光
去放松情绪– 更少的心理压力
[the optimization of building design] – [good ventilation and lighting to ease emotions] – [a decrease in
psychological distress]
例子：大窗户的设计
带来很多新鲜空气– 严重抑郁症的概率降低
[enough fresh air brought by buildings with big windows] – [lower risk of serious depression]
论点
设计缺陷（如隔音很差）损害身心健康
Poor architectural planning can affect mental and physical health.
论证：建筑设计的缺陷 – 室内昏暗隔音差 – 患病或抑郁的风险很高
[the flaws in building design] – [dark space and poor soundproofing] – [high risk of getting ill or depression] 例子
：建筑隔音差– 焦虑感上升
[living in a building with poor soundproofing] – [increased anxiety]
Body Paragraph 2 – 对工作的影响
论点1：降低员工工作积极性***
Inefficient architectural design can weaken employees’ work motivation.
论证：高密度建筑的开发 –
花长时间等电梯– 更低的工作满意度
[the development of high-density buildings] – [long time spent waiting for lifts] – [lower job satisfaction]
例子：
在一个高层写字楼工作– 追求高工作效率的员工的忠诚度下降
[working in a high-rise office building] – [lower job loyalty for employees who seek a high-efficiency working environment]
论点2：工作效率提升
Spacious office buildings can improve work productivity.
论证：办公空间的合理布局– 协作与专注环境的营造 – 员工生产力和满意度的提高
[the thoughtful layout of office spaces] – [the creation of collaborative and focused environments] – [an increase in employee satisfaction]
例子：
将办公空间按照功能区分– 办公室同事之间的干扰很少
[dividing the office space based on its functions] – [less disturbance from colleagues during work]

F101062.title: Some people prefer to live in the city, while others prefer to live in the countryside. What is your opinion and discuss with your own experience.
F101062.title_zh: 有人的倾向住在城市，有的倾向住在乡下郊区，你怎么认为，并用自己的经历讨论？

blocks.p: Some people prefer to live in the city, while others prefer to live in the countryside. What is your opinion and discuss with your own experience.
有人的倾向住在城市，有的倾向住在乡下郊区，你怎么认为，并用自己的经历讨论？

F101062.title: 城市生活与乡村生活，你喜欢哪个？

blocks.p: Living in the countryside or having a city life, which one do you prefer? Please use examples or your personal experience to support your opinion.
生活在乡村还是城市，你更喜欢哪一种？请用例子或个人经历来支持你的观点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：乡村生活
Personally speaking, I prefer living in the countryside.
论点1：精神压力***
Living in the countryside will lead to less mental stress.
论证：乡村生活– 竞争和工作压力的减少 – 更少的心理压力
[countryside life] – [lower levels of competition and work pressure] – [a decrease in psychological distress]
例子：乡村的低物欲生活– 没有由攀比和竞争引发的心理压力
[low material desire of rural life] – [zero mental stress caused by comparison and competition]
论点2：生存环境***
Countryside life can provide residents with a healthy living environment.
论证：乡村的自然环境– 污染和噪音的减少 – 身体健康的改善
[the natural surroundings of rural areas] – [lower levels of pollution and noise] – [an improvement in physical well-being]
例子：郊区清新的空气和绿色景观– 人们的呼吸道疾病降低
[fresh air and green landscapes in suburbs] – [a reduction in respiratory diseases of people]
论点
3：社区关系更紧密
，幸福感更高
Community bonds in the countryside are stronger, and this will lead to higher life happiness.
论证：乡村社区的规模小 – 邻里交往的频繁 – 归属感和安全感增强
[the small size of rural communities] – [frequent interaction among neighbors] – [a stronger sense of belonging and security]
例子：
乡村居民联系更紧密– 日常生活互帮互助
[closer neighbor ties in small towns] – [mutual help and support in daily life]
观点
2：城市生活
Personally speaking, I prefer living in the city.
论点
1：教育机会
City life can provide greater access to educational opportunities.
论证：城市环境– 教育资源丰富 – 为儿童教育打下基础
[urban areas] – [abundant outstanding primary educational resources] – [the firm foundation of children’s education]
例子：生活在上海 – 多样化课外教育机构
[living in Shanghai] – [various extra-curricular education institutions]
论点
生活更便利、安全
Living in cities makes people’s lives more convenient and safer.
论证：城市的建设– 医疗
机构和出行方式多– 生活便捷性和安全性的提高
[the development of cities] – [various medical institutions and transport choices] – [improved efficiency and security of daily life]
例子：城市里发达的公共服务系统 – 快速处理生活中的紧急情况
[well-developed public service system in cities] – [faster treatment of life emergencies]
论点
3：文化和社交生活更丰富
Cities provide a richer cultural and social life.
论证：城市的娱乐场所 – 多样的社交活动
比如朋友聚会– 社交生活的充实
[the entertainment venues of cities] – [a wide variety of social activities such as friend gatherings] – [the
enrichment of social life]
例子：城市里举办的音乐会和展
览– 丰富精神世界并结交更多志同道合的朋友
[concerts and exhibitions held in cities] – [enriched spiritual life and more like-minded friends]

F101122.title: Some people say that life experience can more effectively teach than books or formal education. What’s your opinion? Please provide your experience to explain.
F101122.title_zh: 比起书本知识，生活经验是更有效的教学方式吗？

blocks.p: Some people say that life experience can more effectively teach than books or formal education. What’s your opinion? Please provide your experience to explain.
比起书本知识，生活经验是更有效的教学方式吗？

F101122.title: 与书本，正统教育相比，人生经历经验是更好的老师？

blocks.p: Some people argue that experience is the best teacher. Life experiences can teach more effectively than books or formal school education. How far do you agree with this idea? Support your opinion with reasons and/or your personal experience.
有些人认为经验是最好的老师。生活经验比书本或正规学校教育更有效。你在多大程度上同意这个想法？用理由和/或你的个人经历来支持你的观点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1： 体验式学习有益
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that life experiences can teach more effectively than books or formal school education.
论点
1：实践技能
Life experience can develop students’ practical skills.
论证：在“做中学” – 应用理论知识并解决实际挑战 – 更强的问题处理能力
[the process of learning by doing] – [the application of theory and resolution of practical challenges] – [stronger problem-solving skills]
例子 ：通过生活经历去学习 – 学生动手能力和逻辑思维能力提高
[learning through life experience] – [enhanced hands-on abilities and critical thinking skills]
论点2：知识掌握***
Learning by doing can deepen students' mastery of knowledge.
论证：生活中
主动应用知识– 抽象知识与具体经验的结合 – 更持久的记忆
[active application of knowledge in life] – [the integration of abstract knowledge with concrete experience] – [longer knowledge retention]
例子 ：完成校园调查 – 更好地理解统计方法
[conducting a school survey] – [better understanding of statistical methods]
论点3：提升就业竞争力
Life experience can lead to stronger competitiveness in the job market.
论证：参加
团队项目–
协作能力发展– 有能力应对就业市场的要求
[the experience of a team-based project] – [development of collaborative skills] – [the ability to meet the demands of the job market]
例子 ：参加
小组商业项目– 被HR赏识因为有更好的任务协调能力
[joining a group business project] – [appreciation from HR for better task coordination]
观点
2：体验式学习无益
Personally speaking, life experiences cannot teach more effectively than books or formal school education. 论点
难以系统、正确地传授覆盖知识
Life experience cannot deliver knowledge systematically and correctly.
论证：体验式活动的开展– 大量时间在操作和试错上的消耗 – 错误理解概念性知识
[the conduct of experiential activities] – [the consumption of time in trial and error] – [students’ inaccurate understanding of conceptual knowledge
例子：无指导的实验操作– 学生错误结论的形成
[unguided experimental operations] – [the formation of incorrect conclusions]
论点
2：降低学习效率
Learning through life experience can cause decreased learning efficiency.
论证：自主探索的模式– 教师系统讲解的缺失 – 更慢的教学进度
[the mode of self-exploration] – [the absence of teacher instruction] – [slower learning progress]
例子 ：冗长的实践项目 – 知识吸收效率的降低
[lengthy practical projects] – [a reduced efficiency of mastering knowledge]
论点
3：学生评估困难
Learning through life experience can lead to difficulty in student performance evaluation.
论证：探索式学习 – 开放式学习成果需要
主观的评价– 成绩公平性下降
[exploratory learning] – [open learning outcomes that need subjective evaluation] – [lower assessment fairness] 例子 ：体验式学习 – 教学效果可比性的下降因为评分标准不一致
[experiential learning] – [low comparability of teaching outcomes for inconsistent marking standards]

F101123.title: With the increase of digital media available online, the role of the library has become obsolete. Universities should only procure digital media rather than updating textbooks. Please discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this position.
F101123.title_zh: 大学只用电子资料而不再更新纸质教材，讨论此现象优缺点。

blocks.p: With the increase of digital media available online, the role of the library has become obsolete. Universities should only procure digital media rather than updating textbooks. Please discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this position.
大学只用电子资料而不再更新纸质教材，讨论此现象优缺点。

F101123.title: 大学购买数码媒体取代纸质书的利弊

blocks.p: With the increase of digital media available online, the role of the library has become obsolete. Universities should only procure new digital media rather than constantly update textbooks. Discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this position and give your own point of view.
随着在线数字媒体的增加，图书馆的作用已经过时。大学应该只购买数字材料，而不是不断更新教科书。讨论这个职位的优点和缺点，并给出你自己的观点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点：既有优点，又有缺点
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that there are both advantages and disadvantages of universities procuring new digital media rather than constantly updating textbooks.
Body Paragraph 1 – 优点
论点
提供即时的知识***
Procuring new digital media can provide students with updated knowledge.
论证：数字
书籍–
通过互联网进行内容改动而不是打印– 最新知识的速达
[digital books] – [content changes through the Internet rather than printing] – [rapid access to the latest findings and theories]
例子：在在线平台上做阅读 – 时效性的知识点
[reading on online platforms] – [timely knowledge delivered to all students]
论点
2：降低成本
Digital resources can reduce educational costs.
论证：数字教材– 对印刷和运输成本的节省 – 售价更低
[digital textbooks] – [savings on printing and distribution costs] – [lower prices]
例子：
电子资料和在线图书的使用– 教育经费节省
[using digital materials and online books] – [low budget on education]
Body Paragraph 2 – 缺点
论点
降低学习表现***
Using digital media rather than textbooks can reduce academic performance.
论证：电子屏幕阅读– 短视频和游戏应用的诱惑 – 学习专注力和效率下降
[using electronic devices to read] – [the lure of short-video and gaming apps] – [lower learning concentration and productivity]
例子
：学习时不断查看社交媒体– 作业未能按时完成
[checking social media during study sessions] – [unfinished assignments by the deadline]
论点
妨碍学生深度阅读
Reliance on digital media can hinder deep reading and understanding.
论证：数字书籍的使用 – 纸质阅读深度的缺失 – 理解效果的下降
[the use of digital books] – [the loss of deep reading based on random note-taking] – [a decline in
comprehension]
例子
：高校数字资源– 知识内化程度很浅
[university digital resources] – [a reduction in students' knowledge internalization]

F101124.title: As cities are expanding, some people claim governments should look forward creating better networks of public transportation available for everyone rather than building more roads for vehicle owning population. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
F101124.title_zh: 政府该提供更好的公共交通还是为私家车修更多的路？

blocks.p: As cities are expanding, some people claim governments should look forward creating better networks of public transportation available for everyone rather than building more roads for vehicle owning population. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
政府该提供更好的公共交通还是为私家车修更多的路？

F101124.title: 政府应该改善公共交通还是多修路

blocks.p: As cities are expanding, some people claim governments should look forward to creating better networks of public transport available for everyone rather than building more roads for vehicle owning population. What’s your opinion? Give some examples or experience to support.
随着城市的扩张，一些人声称，政府应该着眼于为每个人创造更好的公共交通网络，而不是为拥有汽车的人口建造更多的道路。你的意见是什么?给出一些例子或经验来支持。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：改善公共交通
Personally speaking, governments should create better networks of public transport available for everyone. 论点
1：降低生活成本
Creating better networks of public transport will reduce the cost of living.
论证：公共交通的廉价票价– 对私家车支出的替代 – 低收入群体出行负担的减轻
[the affordable fares of public transport] – [the substitution for private car expenses] – [a lighter travel burden for low-income groups]
例子：公交车和地铁的推广 – 出行的花费较低
[the promotion of buses and trains] – [lower spending on transportation]
论点2：提高就业率***
Better public transport can improve the employment rate.
论证：公共交通网络的优化– 更多劳动力需求 – 更多就业机会
[the improvement of public transport networks] – [increased labor demand such as subway and bus drivers] – [ more employment opportunities]
例子：轨道交通的发展 – 对地铁服务人员的需求
[rail transit development]– [demand for subway service staff]
论点
3：保护环境
Public transport development will lead to better protection of the environment.
论证：公共交通– 更少化石燃料的消
耗– 清洁空气并可持续发展
[public transportation systems] – [lower fossil fuel consumption] – [cleaner air and improved sustainability] 例子：电动公交车和地铁 – 更好的环境和资源保护
[electric buses and subways] – [improved environmental and resource protection]
观点
2：建造更多道路
Personally speaking, governments should build more roads for the vehicle owning population.
论点
1：节约出行时间
Building more roads will lower commuting time.
论证：建造道路– 增加交通流量承载力 – 交通拥堵程度的缓解
[road construction projects] – [an increased capacity for traffic flow] – [the relief of traffic congestion]
例子
：扩大道路网络– 高峰时段车流运行速度的提升
[expanded road networks] – [higher traffic flow speed during peak hours]
论点
2：促进区域发展
Better road construction will promote regional development.
论证：扩建道路基础设施– 货物运输时间的缩短 – 区域经济的增长
[road infrastructure expansion] – [shorter freight transportation time] – [the growth of the regional economy] 例子
：道路建设– 提高城乡互通
[road construction] – [enhanced access between cities and rural areas]
论点
3：提高就业率
Building more roads can improve the employment rate.
论证：道路建设项目– 更多劳动力需求 – 更多就业机会
[road construction projects] – [increased labor demand such as traffic police and road maintenance staff] – [more employment opportunities]
例子
：道路发展– 对熟练和非熟练工人的需求
[road development]– [higher demand for skilled construction workers]

F101126.title: Some people think that they devote their time to work leaves no time for them to have personal life or private life. How widespread do you think is the problem? What problem of this time shortage will cause?
F101126.title_zh: 人们花太多时间在工作上，缺少个人生活这个问题有多广泛？会导致什么后果？

blocks.p: Some people think that they devote their time to work leaves no time for them to have personal life or private life. How widespread do you think is the problem? What problem of this time shortage will cause?
人们花太多时间在工作上，缺少个人生活这个问题有多广泛？会导致什么后果？

F101126.title: 兼顾工作和私人生活（普遍性与后果）

blocks.p: The time people devote to jobs leaves very little time for personal life. How widespread is the problem? What problem will this shortage of time cause?
人们花在工作上的时间几乎没有留给个人生活的时间。这个问题有多普遍？时间的短缺会导致什么问题？
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点：非常普遍且会带来问题
Personally speaking, the problem is extremely widespread and this shortage of time will cause problems.
Body paragraph 1 – 非常普遍
论点1：生活成本***
High living expenses make the imbalance problem widespread in modern cities.
论证：高生活成本– 为赚取收入而增加工作班次 – 个人生活时间减少
[high living costs] – [more work shifts to earn money] – [less time for personal life]
例子：大城市的高房贷 – 下班后再去跑Uber
[high home loans in large cities] – [Uber driving after office hours]
论点2：工作竞争
Workplace competition can make the problem of having little time for personal life widespread among young people.
论证：职场竞争的加剧– 工作绩效要求的提高 – 私人时间减少
[intensifying workplace competition] – [higher performance demands] – [reduced personal time]
例子：年轻员工
绩效考核的压力– 加班的普遍化
[the pressure of performance evaluation of young employees] – [the prevalence of overtime]
Body paragraph 2 – 时间短缺会带来问题
论点
1：精神
压力***
The problem of work–life balance will lead to mental stress.
论证：没时间给私人生活 – 长期焦虑压抑 – 心理困扰的增加
[little time for personal life] – [fewer chances to relieve pressure from work] – [an increase in psychological distress] 例子
：休闲时间减少– 严重的抑郁症
[less leisure time to do exercise or catch up with friends] – [serious depression]
论点
2：会带来家庭情感问题
The shortage of personal time will generate family relationship issues.
论证：没时间陪伴伴侣– 更多的争吵 – 婚姻关系破裂
[limited time with one’s partner] – [increased chances of getting into fights] – [the breakdown of family
relationships]
例子：较少的家庭互动 – 家庭联系弱
[limited opportunities for family interaction] – [weak family connections]

F101127.title: How is work-life balance important? And why is it difficult to achieve?
F101127.title_zh: 为什么工作生活的平衡很重要？为什么难以达到?

blocks.p: How is work-life balance important? And why is it difficult to achieve?
为什么工作生活的平衡很重要？为什么难以达到?

F101127.title: 兼顾工作与私人生活（重要性与成因）

blocks.p: Nowadays, it is increasingly more difficult to maintain the right balance between work and other aspects of one’s life, such as time with family and leisure needs. How important do you think this balance is? Why do people find it hard to achieve?
如今，在工作和生活的其他方面，比如与家人相处的时间和休闲需求之间保持平衡越来越难了。你认为这种平衡有多重要？为什么人们觉得这个平衡很难实现？
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点：重要，但难以达成
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that the balance is quite important, but it is hard to achieve.
Body Paragraph 1 – 重要性
论点
1：精神压力
The work–life balance will lead to less mental stress.
论证：更多个人和休闲时间– 缓解工作压力的机会 – 更少的心理压力
[more personal and leisure time] – [chances to relax the working stress] – [a decrease in psychological distress] 例子
：工作生活平衡– 严重抑郁症的概率降低
[the balance between work and personal time] – [lower risk of serious depression]
论点
提高工作效率
The balance between work and life can lead to higher work efficiency.
论证：工作生活平衡– 精力和专注力的恢复 – 工作效率和创造力的提升
[work-life balance] – [the restoration of energy and concentration] – [an improvement in work efficiency and creativity]
例子
：工作生活平衡– 心理压力减少 – 生产力更高
[the balance between work and personal time] – [less mental stress] – [higher individual productivity]
Body Paragraph 2 – 成因
论点1：生活成本***
High living expenses make it hard for people to achieve a balance between work and life.
论证：高生活成本– 为赚取收入而增加工作班次 – 个人生活时间减少
[high living costs] – [more work shifts to earn money] – [less time for personal life]
例子：大城市的高
生活成本– 下班后再去跑Uber
[high home loans in modern cities] – [Uber driving after office hours]
论点2：工作竞争
Workplace competition can make the balance hard to achieve.
论证：职场竞争的加剧– 工作绩效要求的提高 – 私人时间减少
[intensifying workplace competition] – [higher performance demands] – [reduced personal time]
例子：绩效考核的压力– 加班的普遍化
[the pressure of performance evaluation] – [the prevalence of overtime]

F101128.title: This era is full of inventions. Please discuss a recent invention that you think is beneficial or detrimental to society.
F101128.title_zh: 本世纪发明集中爆发，论述你认为对社会有益或有害的一项近期发明。

blocks.p: This era is full of inventions. Please discuss a recent invention that you think is beneficial or detrimental to society.
本世纪发明集中爆发，论述你认为对社会有益或有害的一项近期发明。

F101128.title: 描述一个新发明及其优点或缺点

blocks.p: In our technological world, the number of new inventions has been evolving on a daily basis. Please describe a new invention and explain the impact, either beneficial or detrimental, that you feel it has had on society.
在我们的技术世界里，新发明的数量每天都在变化。请描述一项新发明，并解释你认为它对社会产生了有益或有害的影响。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：智能手机
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that the new invention is the smartphone, and it will have beneficial impacts on society.
论点
1：软件可达成多任务处理
Smartphones can enable multitasking via the use of software and applications.
论证：智能手机– 工作与娱乐应用整合 – 一台设备完成多项任务
[smartphones] – [the integration of work and entertainment apps] – [the completion of multiple tasks on one device]
例子
：智能手机使用– 同时完成支付和导航等任务
[using smartphones] – [the completion of multiple tasks such as payment and navigation at the same time]
论点
2：促进即时沟通和社交联系
Smartphones facilitate instant communication and social connections.
论证：智能手机的普及– 即时通讯工具的广泛应用 – 人际沟通效率的提升
[the widespread use of smartphones] – [the broad application of instant messaging tools] – [an enhancement of communication efficiency]
例子：视频通话和社交媒体的使用– 异地亲友联系紧密度的提高
[the use of video calls and social media] – [closer ties with friends and family living far away]
论点
3：提供便捷的信息
和知识获取渠道
Smartphones provide convenient access to information and knowledge.
论证：智能手机的功能– 互联网资源的随时随地获取 – 知识视野的拓展
[the functions of smartphones] – [the on-demand access to internet resources] – [an expansion of knowledge and perspectives]
例子：移动搜索引擎和在线课程的普及– 自学者学习效率的提升
[the prevalence of mobile search engines and online courses] – [an improvement in learning efficiency for self-learners]
观点
2：电动汽车
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that the new invention is the electric vehicle, and it will have beneficial impacts on society.
论点1：降低生活成本***
Electric vehicles will reduce the cost of living.
论证：电动汽车的充电成本– 对高价燃油的替代 – 出行负担的减轻
[the charging cost of electric vehicles] – [the substitution for expensive fuel] – [a lighter travel burden]
例子：在家庭为电动汽车充电 – 出行的花费较低
[home charging for electric vehicles] – [lower spending on transportation]
论点2：提高就业率***
The electric vehicle industry can improve the employment rate.
论证：电动汽车行业的发展–
需要电池研发人员– 更多就业机会给毕业生们
[the development of the electric vehicle industry] – [increased labor demand for battery development staff] – [more employment opportunities for graduates]
例子：电动汽车的发展 – 对新能源汽车设计师的需求
[the promotion of plug-in vehicles] – [higher demand for electric vehicle designers]
论点3：可降低空气污染
Electric vehicles can reduce air pollution.
论证：电动汽车– 使用电池驱动 – 减少有害废气排放
[electric cars] – [electricity powering system] – [less emission of harmful gases]
例子：大力推行电
动汽车– 空气更清洁
[the promotion of electric vehicles] – [cleaner air]

F101132.title: Unemployment among young people is a serious problem. Some people suggest shorter working weeks instead of laying off employees. What do you think are the advantages and disadvantages? Is it also applicable to adults?
F101132.title_zh: 年轻人失业是一个严重的问题。有人建议缩短工作周而不是裁员。你认为有什么利弊？是否也适用于成年人？

blocks.p: Unemployment among young people is a serious problem. Some people suggest shorter working weeks instead of laying off employees. What do you think are the advantages and disadvantages? Is it also applicable to adults?
年轻人失业是一个严重的问题。有人建议缩短工作周而不是裁员。你认为有什么利弊？是否也适用于成年人？

F101132.title: 减少工时以缓解失业率

blocks.p: In modern society, unemployment among young people is a serious problem. One solution is to shorten the working week and put more people to work. Give your opinion of the idea, considering the advantages and disadvantages, whether it can apply to young people or the whole workforce.
在现代社会，年轻人失业是一个严重的问题。一个解决办法是缩短每个人的每周工作时间，让更多人有工作。给出你对这个想法的看法，考虑到优点和缺点，它是否适用于年轻人或整个劳动力。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
适用于年轻人
Personally speaking, shortening the working week and putting more people to work can apply to young people to address unemployment, and it has advantages and disadvantages.
Body Paragraph 1 – 优点
论点
1：提高年轻
人工作积极性***
Shortening the working week and putting more people to work will improve young people’s work motivation. 论证：年轻人对生活工作平衡高度敏感 – 对较少
工时的接受度高– 更高的工作满意度
[young workers’ high sensitivity to the balance between work and life] – [higher acceptance of fewer working hours] – [higher job satisfaction]
例子：更短的工作时间 – 年轻员工的忠诚度提高
[less working time] – [higher job loyalty for young employees]
论点
2：年轻人可以兼顾个人提升
A shorter working week allows the combination of employment and personal development for young people. 论证：缩短工作时间– 继续学习与技能提升 – 更高的学位
[reduced working hours] – [time for further learning] – [higher academic degree]
例子：
在工时较少的公司上班– 工作与自我提升并行
[working in companies requiring fewer working hours] – [balance between work and self-improvement]
Body Paragraph 2 – 缺点
论点
1：影响职业发展
The shortage of working time for young people will hinder their career development.
论证：
减少工作时间– 积累较少的工作经验 – 无法胜任更高级的职位
[reduced working time] – [less work experience accumulated] – [the inability to handle higher-level positions] 例子
：缩短工作天数– 工作能力提升慢
[fewer working days per week] – [slower improvement of working abilities]
论点
2：影响收入
Shortening the working week will bring financial pressure for younger people.
论证：工作时间有限– 收入降低 – 无法偿付日常开支
[limited working hours] – [reduced income] – [inability to cover daily expenses]
例子
：降低工作时间– 没有钱去娱乐消费
[fewer working days per week] – [insufficient income to cover entertainment consumption]
观点
适用于整个劳动力
Personally speaking, shortening the working week and putting more people to work can apply to the whole workforce to address unemployment, and it has advantages and disadvantages.
Body Paragraph 1 – 优点
论点
1：提升社会整体就业率
Shortening the working week and putting more people to work will improve the overall employment rate in society.
论证：个体的工作时间减少– 需要更多轮班 – 创造更多岗位空缺
[reduced working time for individual workers] – [increased need for work shifts] – [more job vacancies created] 例子
：工作时间减少– 招聘的需求上升
[reduced working duration] – [risen demand for hiring]
论点
2：全民享受
更高的生活幸福感
Applying a shorter working week to the whole workforce can promote life satisfaction.
论证：工作时间的缩短– 休闲时间的增多 – 员工幸福感和满意度的提升
[reduced working hours] – [an increase in leisure time] – [an improvement in employees' well-being and satisfaction]
例子：缩短工作周 – 更可持续的工作与生活模式
[a shortened working week] – [a more sustainable work–life balance for society]
Body Paragraph 2 – 缺点
论点
1：增加企业运营成本
Shortening the working week raises operating costs for all companies.
论证：工作时间的缩短–
更多钱要付给新员工相比给老员工加薪– 企业人力成本的上升
[reduced working hours] – [the higher cost of hiring new employees compared with raising salaries for existing staff] – [a rise in companies' labor costs]
例子：工时缩减– 中小企业运营风险的增加
[shorter working hours] – [an operational risk for small and medium enterprises]
论点
2：影响收入
Shortening the working week for the entire labor force will cause financial pressure.
论证：工作时间有限– 收入降低 – 无法偿付大额开支
[limited working hours] – [reduced income] – [inability to cover large expenditure]
例子
：降低工作时间– 用于房贷和孩子教育的资金不足
[fewer working days per week] – [insufficient funds for home loan or children’s education]

F101134.title: Should celebrities give up the right to privacy?
F101134.title_zh: 名人该不该放弃隐私权？

blocks.p: Should celebrities give up the right to privacy?
名人该不该放弃隐私权？

People who are famous entertainers or sportspeople should give up the right to privacy because this is the price of fame. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this point of view? Give your reasons or use your own experiences to support.
那些著名的艺人或运动员应该放弃隐私权，因为这是成名的代价。你在多大程度上同意或不同意这一观点?给出你的原因或用你的经历做支持。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：应该放弃
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that people who are famous entertainers or sportspeople should give up the right to privacy as the price of fame.
论点
1：促进事业发展
People who are famous entertainers or sportspeople giving up privacy can promote their career development. 论证：放弃隐私权– 公众曝光率和知名度 – 事业发展
[giving up privacy] – [more public exposure and attention] – [the enormous rewards of fame]
例子：放弃个人隐私赢取
知名度– 更多职业机会
[giving up personal privacy to win popularity] – [the high earnings of celebrities]
论点
2：名人作为社会榜样，需要行为透明
As social role models, famous people are expected to maintain transparent behavior.
论证：公众人物的身份– 社会榜样作用的发挥 – 行为透明度的高要求
[the status of public figures] – [the performance of a role-model function] – [the high demand for behavioral transparency]
例子：名人
职业理念的要求– 通过行为透明度树立公共形象
[the requirement of celebrities’ professional conduct] – [build a positive public image through transparent behavior]
论点
3：名人隐私的过度保护会损害公众知情权
Excessive protection of celebrities' privacy undermines the public's right to know.
论证：隐私的过度保护– 真实信息的掩盖 – 公众知情权的损害
[excessive privacy protection] – [the concealment of true information] – [damage to the public's right to know] 例子：名人隐瞒不当行为– 品牌方与劣迹艺人合作
[the concealment of misconduct by celebrities] – [brands’ collaboration with disgraced celebrities]
观点
2：不应放弃
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that people who are famous entertainers or sportspeople should not give up their right to privacy.
论点1：精神压力***
Celebrities who give up their right to privacy can lead to more mental stress.
论证：将私生活暴露给媒体 –
一直维持紧绷的生活状态– 心理困扰的增加
[the exposure of private life to the media] – [the state of a tense lifestyle for a long time] – [an increase in psychological distress]
例子
：狗仔队的跟踪偷拍– 严重的抑郁症
[the pursuit of celebrities by paparazzi] – [serious depression]
论点2：安全问题***
Famous individuals giving up the right to privacy can cause safety risks.
论证：个人隐私泄露– 跟踪与骚扰 – 人身和财产安全受到威胁
[exposure of personal privacy] – [stalking and harassment] – [the threat to personal safety and property security] 例子
：放弃个人隐私– 更高风险遭到抢劫或绑架
[giving up personal privacy] – [a higher risk of being robbed or kidnapped]
论点3：侵害公民合法权利
Famous entertainers or sportspeople giving up their privacy will cause the loss of legal rights.
论证：隐私曝光– 个人权利受侵害 – 公民合法权益受损
[privacy exposure] – [a violation of individual rights] – [damage to legal civil rights]
例子
：放弃个人隐私– 隐私侵犯的伤害
[giving up personal privacy] – [the harm of privacy invasion]

论证：互联网和人工智能的发展– 办公自动化的应用 – 工作生产力提升
[Internet and AI development] – [the application of office automation tools] – [the improvement of work
productivity]
例子
：自动化与人工智能– 重复性工作完成得很快
[automation and artificial intelligence] – [the quick completion of repetitive tasks]
论点2：灵活的工作安排***
Flexible working systems can promote fewer working hours.
论证：远程办公和兼职工作 – 根据自身需求灵活控制工作时长 – 有效工作时间的优化
[working from home and taking part-time jobs] – [the flexible adjustment of working hours based on self-needs] – [the optimization of effective working hours]
例子：远程办公的普及– 员工可自由支配时间的增加
[the widespread adoption of remote work] – [an increase in employees' freely disposable time]
论点3：生活工作平衡的重视
The emphasis on work-life balance will bring about fewer working hours.
论证：健康生活方式的普及– 工作与生活平衡的需求 – 员工主动减少工作时长
[the popularity of healthy lifestyles] – [the need for work-life balance] – [employees' voluntary reduction of work hours]
例子
：对身心健康的关注– 自愿避免过度工作
[concern for physical and mental health] – [the willingness to avoid overwork]
观点
2：工作时间不会更短
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that people will not work fewer hours at their jobs.
论点
1：激烈的工作环境
The intense competition in the workplace will cause difficulty in working fewer hours.
论证：经济竞争的加剧– 工作绩效要求的提高 – 加班现象的普遍化
[intensifying workplace competition] – [higher performance requirements to win promotion] – [the prevalence of overtime work]
例子：职场竞争的激烈– 员工自愿加班时间的增加
[fierce workplace competition] – [an increase in employees' voluntary overtime hours]
论点
2：生活压力
Living stress reduces the possibility of working fewer hours.
论证：高生活成本– 收入需求的增加 – 延长工作时间
[high living costs] – [an increase in income needs] – [extended working hours]
例子：需要偿付高额的房贷 – 持续长时间工作
[the need to pay for a high home loan] – [continuous long working hours]
论点
社会不稳定
Reducing working hours will result in social instability.

更多时间去参与不良生活嗜好比如赌博– 反社会行为甚至违法行为上升

[excessive leisure] – [an increase in crime rates and social problems such as alcoholism]

你认为是否应该限制年轻人在25 岁之前做某些事情，比如开车或吸烟？你对此有什么看法？

Age restrictions can be seen everywhere. It is believed that people should not do things until they reach the right age, such as marriage, and driving. Select one activity and state the minimum age that you think. Support with your own experiences.

WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点

Personally speaking, I firmly believe that the minimum age for marriage should be set at twenty.
论点

[the minimum age requirement of twenty to avoid early marriage] – [full concentration on study] – [better academic development]
例子
：结婚年龄限制– 较低的辍学率
[the minimum age of twenty for marriage] – [a lower rate of dropping out of school]
论点
3：减少经济压力
Setting a minimum age of twenty for marriage can contribute to a lower financial burden.
论证：20岁之后 –
很大可能已经就业– 经济独立能力的增强
[People over twenty years old] – [a higher possibility of being employed] – [greater capacity for financial independence]
例子
：结婚年龄限制– 降低婚姻中的经济压力
[the minimum age of twenty for marriage] – [lower financial stress in marriage]
观点
2：开车 18岁
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that the minimum age for driving should be eighteen.
论点
减少青少年犯罪***
Setting a minimum age of eighteen for driving can reduce juvenile delinquency.
论证：开车年龄限制– 应对突发情况和防止事故的能力 – 减少年轻人道路犯罪行为
[the minimum age of eighteen for driving] – [ability to handle emergencies and prevent accidents] – [reduced criminal activities of teenagers on roads]

18岁的最低驾驶年龄 – 更少的未成年道路交通事故
[the minimum age of eighteen for driving] – [fewer traffic accidents caused by minors]
论点
2：承担社会责任
Setting a minimum age requirement of eighteen for driving can build social responsibility among young drivers. 论证：
18岁的最低驾驶年龄 – 深入理解道路安全知识 – 对
社会有益的驾驶行为习惯的建立

establishment of beneficial driving behavioral for society]

F101137.title: 外语应该成为必修课吗

blocks.p: Some people think learning a foreign language at school should be compulsory. To what extent do you agree with it? Use your experience or examples to support your viewpoint.
有些人认为在学校学习外语应该是强制性的。你对此有何看法？请结合自己的经历或实例来支持你的观点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：应该
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that schools should make learning a foreign language compulsory.
论点1：丰富人们的观点***
Learning a foreign language can diversify people’s opinions.
论证：阅读外文文章– 对热点问题有多角度的观点 – 对社会问题有批判性的观点
[reading articles in foreign languages] – [multi–angle opinions on hot issues] – [more critical perspectives on social issues]
例子：学习外语– 更好地理解文化和政治的差异
[learning a foreign language] – [a balanced view of cultural and political differences]
论点2：找工作有竞争力***
Learning a foreign language will improve competitiveness in job hunting.
论证：掌握外语– 满足跨国公司对雇员素质的需求 – 更具职场竞争力
[mastering foreign languages] – [the satisfaction of multinational companies’ demands on employees’ qualities] – [enhanced advantages in the job market]
例子：学习外语– 有能力应聘外企的工作岗位
[studying a foreign language] – [ability to apply for job positions in foreign enterprises]
论点3：促进跨文化交流
Studying a foreign language can lead to the enhancement of cross-cultural communication.
论证：掌握外语– 理解不同的习俗和传统 – 减少因文化差异引起的误解
[learning a foreign language] – [an understanding of its culture] – [reduced misunderstanding due to cultural nuances]
例子：掌握外语– 与外国朋友通过文化交流产生了联系
[proficiently mastering English] – [closer international connections through cross-cultural communication]
观点
2：不应该
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that schools should not make learning a foreign language compulsory. 论点
1：学业压力
Requiring schools to mandate foreign language learning can increase students’ academic burden.
论证：强制学习外语– 额外的作业时长和记忆任务 – 更大的学习压力
[mandatory foreign language courses] – [extended study hours and more memorization tasks] – [greater learning pressure]
例子
：过多的外语学习时间– 较少的时间去放松
[excessive foreign language study time] – [less time for relaxation]
论点
2：增加学校运营成本
Schools enforcing compulsory foreign language education can increase operational expenditure.
论证：增加外语课程– 高薪聘请外语老师 – 增加学校的财政负担
[adding the foreign language courses] – [recruitment of qualified foreign-language teachers] – [increased
financial burden on schools]
例子
：开设外语课程– 花很多钱购买英文原版教材并聘请外教
[mandating foreign language courses] – [huge spending on purchasing original English textbooks and hiring foreign teachers]
论点3：翻译软件可以替代外语学习
Artificial intelligence translators can reduce the need for foreign language study.
论证：人工智能翻译– 即时翻译 – 对语言学习的依赖降低
[artificial intelligence translators] – [instant translation of complex texts] – [less reliance on language learning] 例子：实时语音翻译软件– 不学外语也能理解对话
[real-time voice translation software] – [fast understanding of conversations without foreign language acquisition]

The restoration of historic buildings preserves cultural heritage and historical memory.

F101140.title: Is maximum wage for high income people good or bad for them?
F101140.title_zh: 最高工资限制对于高收入人群来说是好还是坏？

blocks.p: Is maximum wage for high income people good or bad for them?
最高工资限制对于高收入人群来说是好还是坏？
"Should there be a maximum wage for high-paying people?" To what extent do you agree with this statement? Please give your reasons and/or arguments.
“应该为高收入人群设定最高工资标准吗?”你在多大程度上同意这种说法?请给出你的理由和/或论点。
论点支持多题目通用。如需下载《
WE论点
合并》资料，请添加小助手老师。
观点
1：同意限定最高薪资
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that there should be a maximum wage for high-paying people.
论点
缩小贫富差距
A maximum wage can help narrow the wealth gap in society.
论证：最高薪资限制– 抑制过高收入 – 减少收入歧视
[a maximum wage cap] – [the curb on excessive incomes] – [reduced income discrimination]
例子：薪资上限政策– 更公平的收入分配
[wage cap policies] – [a more equitable income distribution]
论点
2：促使企业回报普通员工
A maximum wage can encourage companies to reward ordinary workers.
论证：最高薪资限制– 高管薪酬增长的受限 – 基层员工资源的增加
[wage ceiling] – [limits on executive pay growth] – [more resources for rank-and-file employees]
例子：高管薪资受限– 普通员工薪资和福利的提升
[limited executive compensation] – [improvements in ordinary workers' wages and benefits]
论点
3：促进社会公平与稳定
A maximum wage can promote social fairness and stability.
论证：最高薪资限制– 社会不平等感的降低 – 社会矛盾的减少
[a wage cap] – [a reduced sense of social inequality] – [fewer social conflicts]
例子：最高薪资的限定带来
收入差距的缩小– 社会凝聚力的增强
[a narrowed income gap brought by a maximum wage] – [stronger social cohesion]
观点
2：不同意限定最高薪资
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that there should not be a maximum wage for high-paying people.
论点
1： 阻碍商业发展
A maximum wage can hinder business development.
论证：设置最高薪资限制– 高收入者工作主动性的降低 – 决策延误
[setting a wage cap] – [lower motivation for proactive work among high achievers] – [delays in making business decisions]
例子：
高管工资有上限– 企业运营效率下降
[a maximum wage for top managers] – [lower business operation efficiency]
论点2：降低员工工作积极性***
A maximum wage would weaken talented individuals’ work motivation.
论证：设置最高薪资限制–
对创新和努力工作的回报不足– 更低的工作满意度
[setting a wage cap] – [insufficient rewards for innovation and hard work] – [lower job satisfaction]
例子：薪资上限– 顶尖人才的忠诚度下降
[a salary ceiling] – [lower job loyalty for top talents]
论点3：降低社会整体消费水平
A maximum wage would decrease overall consumption in society.
论证：最高薪资限制– 高收入者可支配收入的减少 – 整体消费的下降
[a wage cap] – [the reduction of high earners' disposable income] – [a decline in total consumer spending] 例子：薪资上限– 高端商品和服务需求的萎缩
[a salary ceiling] – [the shrinkage of demand for high-end goods and services]

The electric eel’s head is positive compared to its tail, which is more negative. The fish has this dipole nature due to the direction of the flow of positive charge through its electric organ. It places its positively charged head at one end of its prey and its negatively charged tail at the other end, and then sends out its shockwaves. Once the job is done, the eel swallows its prey whole!

In these distant times the sun was seen to make its daily journey across the sky. At night the moon appeared. Every new night the moon waxed or waned a little and, on a few nights, it did not appear at all. At night the great dome of the heavens was dotted with tiny specks of light. They became known as the stars. It was thought that every star in the heavens had its own purpose and that the secrets of the universe could be discovered by making a study of them.

It was well known that there were wandering stars, they appeared in different nightly positions against their neighbours and they became known as planets. It took centuries, in fact it took millennial, for man to determine the true nature of these wandering stars and to evolve a model of the world to accommodate them and to predict their positions in the sky.

In geologic terms, a plate is a large, rigid slab of solid rock. The word tectonics comes from the Greek root "to build." Putting these two words together, we get the term plate tectonics, which refers to how the Earth's surface is built of plates. The theory of plate tectonics states that the Earth's outermost layer is fragmented into a dozen or more large and small plates that are moving relative to one another.

Stars and the material between them are almost always found in gigantic stellar systems called galaxies. Our own galaxy, the Milky Way System, happens to be one of the two largest systems in the Local Group of two dozen or so galaxies. The other is the Andromeda galaxy; it stretches more than one hundred thousand light-years from one end to the other, and it is located about two million light-years distant from us.

Coral reefs support more marine life than any other ocean ecosystem and are, not surprisingly, a favorite pursuit for many divers. But as well as being physically and biologically spectacular, coral reefs also support the livelihoods of over half a billion people. What is more, this number is expected to double in coming decades while the area of high-quality reef is expected to halve. In combination with the very real threat of climate change, which could lead to increased seawater temperatures and ocean acidification, we start to arrive at some quite frightening scenarios.

Almost no one regards corn with suspicion. But the same can't be said for humans' ingenious ability to engineer the plants we eat. Genetically modified (GM) crops are viewed with such hostility that they are barely grown in Europe. However, a new study by an independent group of scientists, who have done the most comprehensive review of the evidence so far, shows that our aversion to GM food is pointless, unscientific and harmful to farmers.

Genetically modified foods provide no direct benefit to consumers; the food is not noticeably better or cheaper. The greater benefit, proponents argue, is that genetic engineering will play a crucial role in feeding the world’s burgeoning population. Opponents disagree, asserting that the world already grows more food per person than ever before – more, even, than we can consume.

Your teenage daughter gets top marks in school, captains the debate team, and volunteers at a shelter for homeless people. But while driving the family car, she text-messages her best friend and rear-ends another vehicle.

How can teens be so clever, accomplished, and responsible—and reckless at the same time? Easily, according to two physicians at Children’s Hospital Boston and Harvard Medical School (HMS) who have been exploring the unique structure and chemistry of the adolescent brain. “The teenage brain is not just an adult brain with fewer miles on it,” says Frances E. Jensen, a professor of neurology. “It’s a paradoxical time of development. These are people with very sharp brains, but they’re not quite sure what to do with them.”

In animals, movement is coordinated by a cluster of neurons in the spinal cord called the central pattern generator (CPG). This produces signals that drive muscles to contract rhythmically in a way that produces running or walking, depending on the pattern of pulses. A simple signal from the brain instructs the CPG to switch between different modes, such as going from a standstill to walking.

Memories can become scrambled, sometimes in the process of attempting to retrieve something. You might relate a story to a friend but unwittingly include some mistaken details. Later, as you attempt to recall the episode came, you might come across your memory of the scrambled recall attempt instead of your original memory. Memory is malleable. It is not, as commonly thought, like a museum piece sitting in a display case.

Financing of Australian higher education has undergone dramatic change since the early 1970s. Although the Australian Government provided regular funding for universities from the late 1950s, in 1974 it assumed full responsibility for funding higher education - abolishing tuition fees with the intention of making university accessible to all Australians who had the ability and who wished to participate in higher education. (SEE ENDNOTE 1)

Since the late 1980s, there has been a move towards greater private contributions, particularly student fees. In 1989, the Australian Government introduced the Higher Education Contribution Scheme (HECS) which included a loans scheme to help students finance their contributions. This enabled universities to remain accessible to students by delaying their payments until they could afford to pay off their loans. In 2002, the Australian Government introduced a scheme similar to HECS for postgraduate students - the Postgraduate Education Loan Scheme (PELS).

Funding for higher education comes from various sources. This article examines the three main sources - Australian Government funding, student fees and charges, and HECS. While the proportion of total revenue raised through HECS is relatively small, HECS payments are a significant component of students' university costs, with many students carrying a HECS debt for several years after leaving university. This article also focuses on characteristics of university students based on their HECS liability status, and the level of accumulated HECS debt.

Timing is important for revision. Have you noticed that during the school day you get times when you just don' t care any longer? I don't mean the lessons you don t like, but the ones you find usually find OK, but on some occasions, you just can't be bothered with it. You may have other things on your mind, be tired, restless or looking forward to what comes next. whatever the reason, that particular lesson doesn't get 100 percent effort from you. The same is true of revision. Your mental and physical attitude are important. If you try to revise when you are tired or totally occupied with something else, your revision will be inefficient and just about worthless. If you approach it feeling fresh, alert and happy, it will be so much easier, and you will learn more, faster. However, if you make no plans and just slip in a little bit of revision when you feel like it, you probably won’t do much revision! You need a revision timetable, so you don't keep putting it off.

Team Lab's digital mural at the entrance to Tokyo’s Skytree, one of the world’s monster skyscrapers, is 40 metres long and immensely detailed But however massive this form of digital art becomes -and it's a form subject to rampant inflation--Inoko's theories about seeing are based on more modest and often pre-digital sources. An early devotee of comic books and cartoons (no surprises there), then computer games, he recognised when he started to look at traditional Japanese art that all those forms had something in common: something about the way they captured space. In his discipline of physics, Inoko had been taught that photographic lenses, along with the conventions of western art were the logical way of transforming three dimensions into two, conveying the real world on to a flat surface. But Japanese traditions employed “a different spatial logic“, as he said in an interview last year with jcollabo.org, that is “uniquely Japanese”

Omniscience may be a foible of men, but it is not so of books. Knowledge, as Johnson said, is of two kinds, you may know a thing yourself, and you may know where to find it. Now the amount which you may actually know yourself must, at its best, be limited, but what you may know of the sources of information may, with proper training, become almost boundless. And here come the value and use of reference books—the working of one book in connexion with another— and applying your own intelligence to both. By this means we get as near to that omniscient volume which tells everything as ever we shall get, and although the single volume or work which tells everything does not exist, there is a vast number of reference books in existence, a knowledge and proper use of which is essential to every intelligent person. Necessary as I believe reference books to be, they can easily be made to be contributory to idleness, and too mechanical a use should not be made of them.

Active learning classrooms (ALCs) are student-centered, technology-rich classrooms. They are easily identified with their large circular tables and movable seating designed to improve student engagement in class. Typically, each table is accompanied by a whiteboard and flat-screen monitor to display student work and larger rooms frequently have miniature bulb and microphones and at each table. In this way, students are able to signal if they have questions or want to speak to the entire room. ALCs provide the hands-on environment that has transformed old class from passive lecture to very active group design work.

Life in the UK 2012 provides a unique overview of well-being in the UK today. The report is the first snapshot of life in the UK to be delivered by the Measuring National Well-being program and will be updated and published annually. Well-being is discussed in terms of the economy, people and the environment. Information such as the unemployment rate or number of crimes against the person are presented alongside data on people’s thoughts and feelings, for example, satisfaction with our jobs or leisure time and fear of crime. Together, a richer picture on ‘how society is doing’ is provided.

A surprising number of writers, even those who have thought of their writing as "self-expression," have sought a freedom from the tyranny of subjectivity, echoing Goethe's claim that "Every healthy effort is directed from the inward to the outward world." From time-to-time others have risen to defend commitment, engagement, involvement. But, at least until recently, the predominant demand in this century has been for some sort of objectivity.

In a sequence of bestsellers, including The Language Instinct and How the Mind Works, Pinker has argued the swathes of our mental, social and emotional lives may have originated as evolutionary adaptions, well suited to the lives our ancestors eked out on the Pleistocene savannah. Sometimes it seems as if nothing is immune from being explained this way. Road rage, adultery, marriage, altruism, our tendency to reward senior executives with corner offices on the top floor, and the smaller number of women who become mechanical engineers—all may have their roots in natural selection, Pinker claims. The controversial implications are obvious: that men and women might differ in their inborn abilities at performing certain tasks, for example, or that parenting may have little influence on personality.

More than simply putting flowers in a container, ikebana is a disciplined art form in which nature and humanity are brought together. Contrary to the idea of a particolored or multicolored arrangement of blossoms, ikebana often emphasizes other areas of the plant, such as its stems and leaves, and puts emphasis on shape, line, and form. Though ikebana is an expression of creativity, certain rules govern its form. The artist's intention behind each arrangement is shown through a piece's color combinations natural shapes, graceful lines, and the implied meaning of the arrangement.

What is a country, and how is a country defined?

When people ask how many countries there are in the world, they expect a simple answer. After all, we've explored the whole planet; we have international travel, satellite navigation and plenty of global organizations like the United Nations, so we should really know how many countries there are!
However, the answer to the question varies according to whom you ask. Most people say there are 192 countries, but others point out that there could be more like 260 of them.

So why isn't there a straight forward answer? The problem arises because there isn't a universally agreed definition of 'country' and because, for political reasons, some countries find it convenient to recognize or not recognize other countries.
navigation: n. 航行; 航海
Remember when universities were bursting at the seams with students sitting in the aisles, balancing books on their knees?

No more, it seems. E-learning is as likely to stand for empty lecture theatres as for the internet revolution, which has greatly increased the volume and range of course materials available online in the past five years.

"The temptation now is to simply think, 'Everything will be online so I don't need to go to class'," said Dr Kerri-Lee Krause, of the Centre for the Study of Higher Education at the University of Melbourne.
The nation's universities are in the process of opening the doors for the new academic year and, while classes are generally well attended for the early weeks, it often does not last.
"There is concern at the university level about student attendance dropping and why students are not coming to lectures," Dr Krause said.
But lecturers' pride - and fierce competition among universities for students - mean few are willing to acknowledge publicly how poorly attended many classes are.

English has been changing throughout its lifetime and it's still changing today. For most of us, these changes are fine as long as they’re well and truly in the past. Paradoxically, we can be curious about word origins and the stories behind the structures we find in our language, but we experience a queasy distaste for any change that might be happening right under our noses. There is a certain kind of consistency. There are even language critics who are convinced that English is dying, or if not dying at least being progressively crippled/damaged through long years of mistreatment.

Trees may have a lot to teach us about being part of a community and how cooperation is better for a society than competition. Scientists are only just beginning to understand how it all works, but we now know that trees growing together share all of the available resources with each other. So, strong trees in a very good position will supply food and water to weaker trees that receive less sunlight. They do this through their roots, the soil and also the networks of the tiny fungi that grow in the soil among them.

Mischel is the creator of the marshmallow test, one of the most famous experiments in the history of psychology, which is often cited as evidence of the importance of self-control. In the original test, which was administered at the Bing Nursery School, at Stanford, in the nineteen-sixties, Mischel's team would present a child with a treat and tell her that she could either eat the one treat immediately or wait alone in the room for several minutes until the researcher returned, at which point she could have two treats. The promised treats were always visible and the child knew that all she had to do to stop the agonizing wait was ring a bell to call the experimenter back--although in that case, she wouldn't get the second treat. The longer a child delayed gratification, Mischel found--that is, the longer she was able to wait--the better she would fare later in life at numerous measures of what we now call executive function. She would perform better academically, earn more money, and be healthier and happier. She would also be more likely to avoid a number of negative outcomes, including jail time, obesity, and drug use.

Many tests have shown that, in a very broad way, people in most parts of the world have similar color preferences. Blue is the most preferred and popular hue, followed in order by red, green, purple, yellow and orange. Overlaying this basic order of color preference, however, are the responses of individuals, which of course vary widely and may also be very powerful. Children are likely to have strong preferences for some colours and aversions to others, but sometimes will not admit to them, since outside factors may be influential in determining both colour preferences and the way that they are expressed or suppressed. Current fashions in clothes and accessories, gender-stereotyping and peer-group pressure may all play a significant part. Boys in particular may be reluctant to admit to any strong preferences for colours other than those of favourite football teams, because colour awareness may be regarded by their peer group as feminine.

I think there is an intense competition at the moment to hire the most talented and most intellectually able people. There is a time when I think companies have many of the adventures in the world. We have this sense of immigrants being things that countries are battled to keep out, and immigrants want to get in, climb of the walls. I think the opposite isn’t the case. And the topic is that countries are trying to lure bright young people to get them to go to universities and get them to become immigrants.

So, on many levels, talent is a premium. There is a shortage of talent, and so countries, companies, all sorts of organizations, of course, volunteer organizations as well as, are competing to hire the best and the brightest. You know we have a baby-boom population which is aging. We have an economy which is becoming more sophisticated. And so, for all those sorts of reasons, talent is a premium.
